data.title: Dermatome
data.summary: Blades & scalpels · Disposable or powered device that harvests split-thickness skin grafts of set thickness.
data.body:
_Also called: Powered skin graft harvester_

Disposable or powered device that harvests split-thickness skin grafts of set thickness.

## Types / variants
- Simon Davol dermatome - small rechargeable unit for small grafts
- Brown (electric) dermatome - adjustable split-thickness graft depth, about 0.2-0.75 mm (0.008-0.030 inch)

## Uses / indications
- Harvesting split-thickness skin grafts

## Viva points & tips
- Graft thickness corrected from source (Khopkar prints 3-8 mm) to the standard split-thickness range of about 0.2-0.75 mm
